status: proposed during preparation; frozen by the commit that root reviews before granting

budgets.existing_regression_frames: counted separately; not part of the 24/48 budgets

builds.note: tests-render keeps the brief's numeric-test package selection (-p incant_render alone). The review helper is copied into the child checkout only after tests-render and tests-host are frozen.

review.rerun_rule: A second run of a case is allowed only after an infrastructure failure (timeout, or a crash before report.json exists). It never replaces a recorded comparison or timing failure, and both runs stay in the ledger.

probe.purpose: Adapter, backend, adapter/device timestamp feature flags and period for Renderer::new and Renderer::new_with_gpu_timing; default constructor requests no timestamp feature; stats/take before any frame.

lit.purpose: Shadow look-dev geometry with a shadowing sun, environment fill and two clustered point lights. Timing off: two frames on one device and one frame on a second device (determinism and cross-device controls). Timing on: three measured frames fill the three slots with unread results, a fourth renders with instrumentation skipped, the consumer drains, and a fifth frame reuses a slot. All eight frames are compared byte for byte.

sprites_text.purpose: Pixel-perfect camera (100 px/unit, 320x180 logical, integer upscale) with three nearest-sampled sprites and world-space Latin/Arabic/CJK/.notdef text; no models.

viewport.purpose: The lit scene inside a fractional, offset, rounded editor-style viewport over a canvas color.

owner_drop.grant_approval: run only if review-ready.json lists "owner_drop" in approved_extra_cases
owner_drop.purpose: Submit one measured 64x64 frame (numeric-test fixture, non-readable target), drop the owning Renderer before its mapping callback, then wait on a retained device clone; afterwards a fresh timing renderer starts empty. Observes absence of panic/hang only; the orphaned result is unobservable by design.

totals.counting: Every rendered review frame counts once as an appearance frame, including controls and frames whose PNG is not retained. Every timing-enabled review frame also counts as a numeric submission, and so does every numeric-test submission. Pixel readback copies are part of their frame's observation, not extra frames.

order: gpu.py review probe|lit|sprites_text|viewport [owner_drop only if approved]
analyze.py check (CPU only) and personal inspection of every retained frame
